identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon

leadText: In , Ash Ketchum travels to the tropical Alola region with his mother and his buddy . Enrolling in the Pokémon School, he befriends his new , , , , and . Gifted a Z-Ring by the , Ash undertakes the island challenge to master Alola's powerful Z-Moves. The Alola region ends up becoming a second home for Ash as he and his classmates face challenges and threats together, such as the mysterious interdimensional , the troublesome thugs of Team Skull, and the newly established Alola Pokémon League, where the title of Alola's first is up for grabs.
